Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 114 as introduced, beginning January 1, 2021, would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes on utility trailers. This bill could reduce receipts to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of utility trailers owned and used by volunteer rescue squads that would not be subject to ad valorem taxation and license and registration fees.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development

Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 114 as introduced, beginning January 1, 2021, would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes on utility trailers. This bill could reduce receipts to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of utility trailers owned and used by volunteer rescue squads that would not be subject to ad valorem taxation and license and registration fees.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education, this exemption would begin January 1, 2022.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/29/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 114 as passed the Senate would exempt volunteer rescue squads from the payment of license and registration fees and ad valorem taxes on utility trailers beginning January 1, 2022. This bill would reduce receipts to the Public School Fund, the State General Fund, the Alabama Veterans Assistance Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund and county and municipal funds, cumulatively, by an estimated $1,400 annually, based on information provided by the Alabama Association of Rescue Squads.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
